items.heading: Zigni
details: Key ingredients: beef, berbere spice, onion, tomato
Saute a large amount of onion until deeply softened.
Add berbere spice paste and cook until fragrant.
Stir in beef and tomato, simmering until the meat is tender.
Serve the spicy stew over injera flatbread.

items.heading: Injera
details: Key ingredients: teff flour, water
Mix teff flour with water into a thin batter and let it ferment for days.
Pour the fermented batter onto a large hot griddle in a spiral.
Cover and cook until small bubbles (eyes) form across the surface.
Remove without flipping and let cool into a soft, spongy flatbread.
